# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
3. Record the tested electrical appliance.
4. Record all test results, along with the tester and date.
5. Mark everything you fail as "fail."
6. Record where the item was tested.
7. Record the name of the person who performed the test.

**Please note:**
* This document does not cover the most common causes of electrical appliance failures.
* Most likely, my handyman will never fail a safety test.
* Don't let this page stop you from learning how to check electrical appliances – use the back of the document or a piece of paper to make the correction.
